style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, airy sky blue #AED6EA with soft clouds for hero claim, warm ivory fabric #F5F1EC with champagne-gold framed rounded cards for infographic screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line champagne-gold icons and slim gold frame cards only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle window-like key from the left, controlled glass highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft romantic fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, airy sky blue #AED6EA, champagne-gold accent #D8B08C, blush liquid tone #F3D9D4 and charcoal text #3A3532; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line champagne-gold icon style; clean high-end glass-bottle photography mixed with minimal gold-framed rounded cards; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the bottle across the set, bottle always upright with cap on
style.surfaceSystem: rippled soft ivory fabric dune #F5F1EC with a pale wood slice pedestal, and matte ivory board #F0EAE2 for flat lays
